title: L3 Human-signed scenario plan
description: Human-signed expectation (O4 oracle) committed to the evidence bundle BEFORE the runtime runs. The signoff timestamp must precede the runtime verdict.
x-schema-changelog: v1: initial contract. The actor enum excluded 'verifier'; expected_verdict was strictly ALLOW|DENY; human_signoff_provenance was absent, so under additionalProperties:false a REAL recorded Human signoff could not validate.

v2: reconciles the documented L3-AUD-002 tension (docs/phase-5/l3/live-plans/0006 §4). Adds actor 'verifier' for independent verification-only scenarios; permits expected_verdict 'INVALID' ONLY when actor is 'verifier' (an integrity-verification outcome, e.g. a tampered ledger detected by chain re-computation, THREAT-018); adds the optional human_signoff_provenance field needed to express a real recorded signoff. Execution scenarios remain restricted to ALLOW|DENY: INVALID is a verification outcome, never an execution outcome.

actor.description: Who performs the planned action. 'verifier' is the independent observer performing verification-only work; it holds no execution authority.

expected_verdict.description: ALLOW|DENY for execution scenarios. INVALID is permitted ONLY for actor=verifier, enforced by the conditional below.

human_signoff_provenance.description: How the signoff was obtained. 'recorded' means an actual Human interaction was captured and is re-derivable; it is the only value that may support a real L3 claim (see tests/l3_runner/environment/readiness.py::_real_human_signoff_observed). Absent means the plan is an inert fixture/template and cannot support a claim.

allOf.description: INVALID is a verification outcome, not an execution outcome: only actor=verifier may expect it.
The independent verifier performs verification only; it never expects an execution verdict.
